notes: Structure follows the Anthropic skill-authoring guide's evaluation format. There is no built-in runner; execute each query against a fresh Claude instance with the skill loaded (Claude Code or claude.ai) and judge against expected_behavior. URLs must be replaced with real frames from a test Figma file the FIGMA_TOKEN can read. Each eval targets a previously observed failure mode.

evals.query: Implement this design in our app: https://www.figma.com/design/<KEY>/<File>?node-id=<single-frame> — the repo is at ./app
expected_behavior: Copies the progress checklist into the response and checks items off while working
Runs figma-to-json.js and opens BOTH screen.json and screen-render.png before writing any code
Runs extract-tokens.js with --match-existing pointed at the repo, and references reusedName (not a new val) for every matched token
Generated screen code contains zero Color(0xFF...) literals, zero inline TextStyle constructors, and at most 1-2 Modifier.offset calls
Every Res.drawable / R.drawable reference corresponds to a file exported into assets/ during this run
Verifies the result against the render (Maestro capture, screenshot test, or explicit side-by-side review) before declaring done
Final summary lists reused tokens and composables by name

evals.query: Build all the screens in this section: https://www.figma.com/design/<KEY>/<File>?node-id=<section-with-3+-frames>
expected_behavior: One exporter run produces a separate figma-out/<screen>/ directory per frame plus index.json (no single tree spanning all screens)
Reports the screen list and processing order to the user before generating
Runs detect-components.js over ALL screen.json files in one invocation and acts on ACROSS SCREENS findings: shared structures become one composable, created once and reused
Processes screens sequentially through the full pipeline, re-running find-composables.js between screens
Does not run cleanup.js until after the final screen's review passes

evals.query: Give me the Compose code for just this button: https://www.figma.com/design/<KEY>/<File>?node-id=<component-node>
expected_behavior: Exports only the component subtree (node-id pins the export; no whole-screen export)
If detect-variants.js exits non-zero, STOPS and asks about missing states instead of inventing pressed/disabled colours
Searches composable-inventory.json before writing a new composable; if an equivalent exists in the repo, reuses or wraps it instead of emitting a parallel implementation
Emits a single parameterised @Composable named from the component (PascalCase), with tokens not hex literals

evals.query: Implement this screen: https://www.figma.com/design/<KEY>/<File>?node-id=<frame> — note our design system already has SurfacePrimary, OnSurface, and AppTopBar in shared/designsystem/
expected_behavior: figma-token-reuse.json drives every colour decision: hexes matching SurfacePrimary/OnSurface reference the existing names with correct imports; no parallel vals are created
The top bar reuses AppTopBar directly or via a feature-local wrapper; shared/designsystem/ files are not modified without the explicit-confirmation handshake
Dimensions.kt (if emitted) contains only values used 2+ times per dimensions.json; one-off dp values stay inline
Review checklist items a-i are explicitly walked before the final summary
